title: Generate Clean Standalone Mesh-Only Adaptive Remesh Visualizations (No Phase-Field Damage, No Rainbow Colormaps, No Crack-Path Lines)
purpose: Generate clean, publication-quality standalone adaptive-remesh images displaying only the authentic finite-element mesh wireframe without phase-field damage contours, rainbow coloring, or crack-path overlays, showing the specimen geometry and refinement zones clearly for the full specimen and primary/secondary zooms.
governing_constraints: Clean white or very light background with thin dark element edges
Loading pin holes and central circular void as white cutouts with dark boundaries
Initial notch rendered clearly with actual geometry (10 x 0.4 mm at y = 70 mm)
No phase-field damage contours, no rainbow/jet coloring, no crack-path overlays
Deliverables committed and pushed to GitHub with direct RAW PNG links
